meta.title: Qwixit — Don't rewrite it. Qwixit.
meta.description: AI on the go for macOS. Select text in any app, hit ⌥⌘X — fixed, translated or rewritten in place.

hero.subLead: You keep writing. Qwixit keeps up.
hero.subBody: AI on the go — in Slack, Mail, Notion, anywhere you type.

demo.label: Animated demo: Qwixit rewriting text in place

modes.fixCopy: Typos, tone, translation. Tap once — repeat last action. Tap twice — the palette. Replace, insert below, or open in a card.
modes.fixMockLabel: Qwixit action palette with Fix, Translate and Shorten actions.
modes.peekCopy: A floating card that translates, summarizes or clarifies the selection. Your text stays exactly as it is.
modes.peekMockLabel: Qwixit Peek card showing a Ukrainian to English translation.

cta.privacy: Text is sent only when you press the shortcut. No keystroke monitoring. Nothing retained.
